summary: Executables should use an approved shebang like #!/bin/sh or #!/usr/bin/env python, while modules must not be executable and must use #!/usr/bin/python.
questions: What shebang should an Ansible module have?
Which shebangs are allowed for scripts?

answer_card.title: shebang test
answer_card.answer_md: Allowed: `#!/bin/sh`, `#!/bin/bash -eu`, `#!/bin/bash -eux`, `#!/usr/bin/make`, `#!/usr/bin/env python`, `#!/usr/bin/env bash`. Modules must **not** be executable and always use `#!/usr/bin/python`.
